sentence: An 18-month-old, 10-kg girl was transferred from her hospital of origin due to septic shock (maximum norepinephrine 1.5 µg/kg/min, mechanical ventilation 21 days, CID); APD was started 40 hours after admission due to anuria, rise in creatinine (baseline 0.7 mg/dl, subsequent 2.3 mg/dl) and balance of +2,360 ml.

APD is started on day 2 with 1.36% fluid, hourly doses of 10 ml/kg, stay 20 minutes, with D/P ratios of urea, creatinine and Dt/Do glucose of 0.91, 0.83 and 0.33, respectively, with effective ultrafiltration between 405 and 700 ml/day.
To obtain a negative net balance we had to increase the concentration of the dialysis fluid to 3.27%.

We observed that with a volume of 15 ml/kg and 10 minutes of permanence, time pass, at 3.27% the value of the ratios was 0.51, 0.47 and 0.41 (the clearance of substances was not excessive, but we still had enough osmotic gradient), so we increased the permanence to 15 and later to 20 minutes with the following D/P ratios of urea, creatinine and Dt/Do glucose: 0.65, 0.61, 0.41, and 0.75, 0.59, 0.35 respectively, with stabilization of the upward trend in creatinine at 4 mg/dl.

On day 21, cloudy dialysate was observed with little cellularity and increased proteins, so we decreased the concentration of the liquid to 2.27% and allowed it to remain for 4 hours with 15 ml/kg per pass and 4 passes per day (in peritonitis, recommends increasing the residence time and decreasing the concentration of the infused solution4).

Under these circumstances, the values ​​of the D/P ratios of urea, creatinine and Dt/Do glucose were 1.04, 0.85 and 0.14 respectively, so we reduced the duration to 2 hours, 6 daily passes with equal volume. and type of fluid, obtaining ratios of 1.01, 0.76 and 0.23 with a decrease in creatinine in 36 hours from 4.2 mg/dl to 3.3 mg/dl (kidney function of 6.6 ml/dl). min/1.73 m2 by urinary creatinine clearance and 9 ml/min/1.73 m2 by Schwarz formula).

On day 27 with 6 daily passages with 1.36% glucose at 15 ml/kg and a 2-hour stay, the ratios were 1.04, 0.92 and 0.13, so we reduced the stay to 90 minutes and subsequently 60 minutes, being able to increase the number of daily passes up to 9, obtaining ratios of 0.98, 0.88 and 0.38 (with 60 minutes of permanence we obtained the same purification as with 120; by being able to perform more passes we would improve purification and ultrafiltration), and a decrease in creatinine from 2.7 to 1.8 mg/dl (renal function of 15 ml/min/1.73 m2 by urinary creatinine clearance and 19 ml/min/1.73 m2 by Schwarz formula), which allowed the DPA to be suspended.
